description: Header file declaring functions and constants for gzip stream support in FreeType, including opening gzip streams and decompressing gzip data.

methods.name: FT_Stream_OpenGzip
methods.description: Opens a new stream to parse gzip-compressed font files, supporting gzip font formats.

methods.name: FT_Gzip_Uncompress
methods.description: Decompresses a gzip-compressed input buffer into an output buffer, similar to zlib's uncompress function.
